text: The zombie-developer Halloween cover art became the title slide of the pitch deck, copied into the deck's assets as `cover-yolo.jpg` and set above a dark band with the title, tagline and team names so the stone "YOLO" letters stay visible. After a screenshot of the built deck looked right and a scan of the staged changes found no secrets or `~` paths, it was committed with the pending `.yolo-twice/` session updates and pushed to `bar9/yolo-twice`. The Pages workflow succeeded, the deck is live at https://bar9.github.io/yolo-twice/pitch/, and the other two downloaded images are unused.
